description: This file contains the implementation of a 'Like' predicate used for pattern matching within querying mechanisms, specifically the class LikePredicateImpl which extends AbstractSinglePredicate and provides conversion of wildcard patterns into regex syntax.

classes.name: LikePredicateImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a 'Like' predicate for pattern-based filtering, converting string patterns with wildcards into regex for matching.

methods.name: LikePredicateImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the predicate with a specified pattern value.

methods.name: convertToRegexSyntaxAndGetOption
methods.description: Transforms the pattern string with wildcards into a regex pattern, optimizing for prefix or postfix matches.

methods.name: replaceRepeatingWildcards
methods.description: Simplifies sequences of multiple asterisks into a single asterisk.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing PredicateVisitor to operate on this predicate.
